digest.component_or_area: pytest fixtures / test harness environment handling
propositions: Seven pytest fixtures return complete dict(os.environ) copies that expose unrelated ambient credentials when pytest renders fixture arguments during long tracebacks.
pytest default long traceback rendering via saferepr serializes fixture arguments/locals, leaking arbitrary inherited environment variables to test output.
Minimal-environment test run with only fake-bin-first PATH and explicit declared variables passes all affected fixture consumers, proving no behavioral dependency on arbitrary ambient keys.
Each of the seven decorated fixtures now returns a fresh mutable allowlisted mapping containing only required PATH, state paths, and per-test overrides instead of copying complete os.environ.
Replacing broad ambient copy with explicit allowlist preserves mutable environment overrides for existing tests while eliminating unrelated ambient credential exposure.
